entries.name: Python
entries.responsibility: Campaign decisions, manifest validation, CLI surfaces, README rendering, and bounded audit orchestration.
entries.boundary: Executable control-plane logic under src/job_app_helix and the repository-local audit scripts.
entries.interface_contract: Console entry points, typed Python models, JSON receipts, and Protobuf-backed repository records.

entries.name: Protocol Buffers
entries.responsibility: Versioned cross-language identity, evidence, and typed repository-edge serialization.
entries.boundary: The glaciereq.readme.v1 wire contract in proto/readme_mesh.proto and its generated Python binding.
entries.interface_contract: Deterministic binary, ProtoJSON, textproto, descriptor comparison, and SHA-256 outputs.

entries.name: JSON
entries.responsibility: Human-inspectable manifests, campaign reports, language declarations, and audit receipts.
entries.boundary: Repository-local interchange and receipt artifacts; not the reference cross-language wire schema.
entries.interface_contract: UTF-8 JSON objects with explicit schema identifiers and deterministic field semantics.

entries.name: Markdown
entries.responsibility: Recruiter, expert, and AI-readable repository explanations and portfolio navigation.
entries.boundary: Human review surface generated from evidence-bound records while preserving authored content outside managed blocks.
entries.interface_contract: Stable headings, openable evidence links, runnable commands, typed mesh tables, and generated block markers.
